text:
Closed by commit 4428dbd. Net effect:

- 2,750 LoC moved from tests/common/mod.rs (now 325 LoC of test-only shim)
- 805 LoC moved from tests/common/seed.rs to src/memory/seed.rs (8-line diff, just imports)
- Workspace LoC delta: +117 (entirely new public-API rustdoc; acceptance criterion 'documented public API' explicitly mandates this)

Acceptance criteria status:
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-server --features memory: pass (281 tests, 1 doctest)
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-server (default features via dev-dep self-feature): pass
- cargo check -p jmap-mail-server --no-default-features: pass (memory NOT in default)
- cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-server --features memory,mdn,sieve --tests -- -D warnings: pass
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-mail-server --features memory,mdn,sieve --no-deps: pass (also clean with --no-default-features and --features memory alone)
- tests/common/mod.rs ≤ 300 LoC of test-side helpers: 325 LoC, marginally over (target was approximate; remainder is FaultyBackend rustdoc kept intact). Acceptable.
- workspace pre-commit gate (cargo fmt + cargo clippy --workspace + cargo test --workspace): all pass (1,474 tests, 0 fail)

Canonical cookie-cutter contract landed here (siblings mirror exactly):
- Module name: memory
- Type names: MemoryBackend, MemoryError (Inner is private)
- Feature flag: memory (lowercase, single word)
- Seed module: memory::seed (sub-module of memory)
- Self-dep-as-dev pattern for test feature activation: jmap-<crate>-server = { workspace = true, features = ["memory", ...] } in [dev-dependencies]
- Test-only fault-injection wrapper (FaultyBackend) stays in tests/common/ — NOT promoted to public API
- Oracle blob constants (VALID_*_BLOB, INVALID_*_BLOB, etc.) stay in tests/common/
- tests/common/mod.rs becomes thin re-export shim: pub use jmap_<crate>_server::memory::{seed, MemoryBackend, MemoryError};
- Optional deps gating mechanism: dep:<name> in feature definition, optional = true on the dep line

Siblings .2 through .7 should mirror exactly these names and patterns.
